Name: SANI RESORT
Company description: Sani Resort is a luxurious landscape stretching across fragrant pine forests, golden sands and crystal clear waters. This is the awe-inspiring thousand-acre natural backdrop to Sani Resort, home to five multiple-awarded 5-star hotels recognized around the globe by leading travel organizations. Five stunning properties all within walking distance of each other, yet far enough away to create a real sense of individuality. While the beating heart of Sani is the vibrant, glamorous Marina with its sumptuous restaurants, bars and boutiques. Employees are the most valuable asset at Sani Resort and our aim is to develop staff skills and help them to reach their potential. We are always on the outlook to identify, recruit and maintain the people with the greatest smile and passion to provide exceptional guest services, which characterises the whole company  Do you enjoy smiling? Join our team!

Name: COSTA NAVARINO
Company description: Costa Navarino is a sustainably driven destination in the Mediterranean, located in Messinia in the southwest Peloponnese of Greece.  Graced with a breath-taking seaside landscape, this is a region shaped by 4,500 years of history. The Costa Navarino philosophy is driven by a genuine desire to preserve the natural beauty and heritage of Messinia. The destination comprises several distinct sites featuring five-star hotels, luxury private residences, a world-class golf experience, and many year-round activities. Navarino Dunes is home to The Romanos, a Luxury Collection Resort, The Westin Resort Costa Navarino and Costa Navarino Residences. Navarino Bay is the setting for Mandarin Oriental, Costa Navarino, W Costa Navarino and Navarino Agora, a curated marketplace. Both sites have signature golf courses, while at Navarino Hills there are two further signature golf courses.

Name: Mitsis Group
Company description: As Greece’s largest privately-owned hotel chain, MITSIS has been a tourism pioneer for 50 years now, making its own mark on Greece’s tourist industry, driven by a customer - centered philosophy and the promise of an unparalleled holiday experience.  With 24 hotels in our portfolio in Athens, Chalkidiki, Corfu, Crete, Kamena Vourla, Kos, Rhodes, Piraeus and Santorini, we aspire to stand out as the preferred portfolio of hotels & resorts in Greece offering excellent service, great locations, impeccable facilities, sophisticated dining and a broad spectrum of options for our clientele.  We bring to life enriching experiences for our guests, making the most of our unparalleled family touch and genuine Greek essence, always seeking to be flexible and adaptable to individual customer needs and the mindset of new generations.  Transforming each visitor into a special guest is the key to our success.  Mitsis Group has been awarded several prizes by local and international tour operators and travel organizations in recognition of the high quality of the services provided, its contribution to upgrading local tourism and its respect for the environment. We are proud to be named Great Place To Work® Certified™ thanks to our people.

Name: Scorpios
Company description: Never sitting still at the intersection of hospitality, gastronomy, architecture, design, music and visual art, Scorpios is a constellation of gathering places that brings cultural experimentation to sublime natural surroundings. Dreamed up in 2015 on a sun-drenched southern tip of Mykonos, the brand's flagship project soon became synonymous with the revival of the Greek island's left-field electronic music scene as a community organically blossomed, bringing mindfulness, visual art, fashion, and craft into the fold. Catching the attention of Soho House in 2019, Scorpios then set its sights further afield.  In 2024, Scorpios unveiled its new flagship location on a secluded peninsula along Turkey’s Bodrum Aegean coast, introducing its first accommodations and wellness offerings to deliver a round-the-clock experience. By nurturing the community, prioritising wellbeing in all its forms, encouraging creative collaboration, and framing nature's beauty, the Scorpios and Soho House partnership looks forward to opening projects in Athens and Dubai.

Name: SantAnna
Company description: SantAnna offers unpretentious luxury and sophisticated entertainment on the prominent island of Mykonos.  Located on Paranga Beach on the south of the island, protected from the Mykonian winds, boasts a Beach Club, 3 restaurants with revisited Mediterranean cuisine, sushi and a raw bar and one of the biggest seawater swimming pools in Europe, retail shops, a wellness center and many different lounge areas are also available for the constant indulgence of the visitors with a choice of exclusive services upon request.  SantAnna is the most diverse project of the Nice-n-Easy Restaurant Group which includes eight successful organic restaurants; Nice-n-Easy Mykonos at the island’s town and Nesaea with contemporary creative Greek island cuisine on Agia Anna Beach at Kalafatis, two Nice-n-Easy restaurants in Athens in Kolonaki and Kifissia & the Italian bistro & bar Frankie in Athens. In May 2018, the newest addition to the group, "nice n easy" Seaside, debuted in the Greek capital’s most iconic location, Astir Beach. "Nice n easy" group is also operating the “Exquisite Catering,” which is a leading catering service on Mykonos for private villas and hotels, offering its services across Greece.

Name: Aldemar Resorts
Company description: With over 35 years in the tourism industry, Aldemar Resorts, owned by the Angelopoulos family, delivers exceptional hospitality and unique guest experiences through a people-centered approach. Aldemar Olympian Village is a luxurious seafront grand resort in Ilia, near Ancient Olympia, offering premium facilities, high-end gastronomy, wellness at the Elements Spa, and state-of-the-art conference and events services at the Ilis Congress Center. Committed to quality, innovation, and sustainability, Aldemar Resorts creates memorable experiences while respecting the environment and supporting local communities.

Name: Astir
HQ Location: Greece, Attica, Athens, 8 Anagyrountos Av. Vari/
Company description: Located in the Athenian Riviera, one of the most coveted areas in Greece, the iconic Astir has long been favored by an elite clientele, as a landmark destination of international stature. Since the 1960s, this instant classic has been offering an exclusive environment of elegant, timeless luxury. In 2016, the company is acquired by Jermyn Street Real Estate Fund IV LP, an investment fund whose investors comprise two sovereign state funds from Abu Dhabi and Kuwait, other Arab investors and the Turkish Dogus Group.  Our redevelopment plan involves the Hotel's complete renovation, a significant upgrade of Astir Marina, the development of up to 13 private villa residences and the renovation of Astir Beach.  In 2017, Astir Palace Vouliagmeni S.A. and Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts, the world's leading luxury hospitality company, announced plans to bring the first Four Seasons hotel to Greece on the Astir peninsula. Following extensive upgrades to the existing hotels, the new hotel will debut as Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens. Now, Astir is setting a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in the country, best serving our vision to be a top luxury destination in the wider Mediterranean region that will harmoniously combine timeless elegance with modern luxury, providing a truly unique hospitality experience. In addition to the Hotel, Astir features high-end retail and dining options, including cosmopolitan Matsuhisa Athens by Nobu; Astir Beach, an alluring seaside concept that boasts 800 sunbeds and impeccable hosting services and Astir Marina, with mooring capacity of 103 vessels. Always a pioneer in concepts & services, the cornerstone of Astir’s success lies in our friendly, dedicated team’s unwavering commitment to integrity, innovation and quality in all facets of hospitality practices. Astir is an equal opportunity employer.

Name: Club Hotel Casino Loutraki
Company description: Club Hotel Casino Loutraki was founded in 1995 and employs 1600 staff. It is the top casino in Greece and one of the largest and most successful casino resorts in Europe.

Name: Myconian Collection Hotels & Resorts
Company description: We are a family-owned group of fourteen leading luxury hotels on Mykonos, including four Relais & Châteaux, two Leading Hotels of the World, three Design Hotels, two Preferred Hotels & Resorts, a Small Luxury Hotels of the World and one The Set. The Myconian Collection lays claim to some of the island’s most beautiful settings, capturing the essence of the incomparable Myconian charm and beauty which attracts travellers from across the world. Founded in 1979 by George and Elefteria Daktylides, the hotels are run today by their four sons Panos, Markos, Vangelis and Marios. As a genuine Myconian family, we welcome guests with warmth and attentiveness and create the ultimate hospitality experience that comes straight from the heart. We offer discerning guests a choice of the most spectacular locations and spacious design interiors. Our gourmet restaurants, state-of-the-art Thalasso spa centres and superb terrace bars set the stage for unbeatable vacations, exceptional events and the most glamorous weddings in the Mediterranean. We are also internationally renowned for our supreme service standards born from family values and refined over decades at the forefront of the island’s hotelier elite. Yet while consistent excellence runs through our superb spas, gourmet restaurants, outstanding conference facilities and glamorous wedding venues, each one of our hotels retains its own distinctive personality, a diverse range of accommodations, entertainment options and rates.

Name: Electra Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Welcome to Electra Hotels & Resorts, a group committed to offering quality hospitality, service and luxury since 1965. In Electra Hotels & Resorts, hospitality becomes a whole new experience. Apart from the high quality facilities and services you expect from a luxury hotel, their superb position in Greece’s most historic and picturesque locations and their wonderful blend of elegance and tradition transforms your accommodation in Electra Hotels & Resorts to a lifetime memory. The company’s mission is to continue offering the traditional Greek hospitality to its clients and at the same time to improve the provided facilities and services.

Name: Mar-Bella Collection Greece
Company description: Mar-Βella Collection is a constantly evolving Hotel Group aiming into offering award-winning holiday experiences featured by service of excellence, personalized care, and dedication to customers. Name: PORTO CARRAS GRAND RESORT
Company description: Porto Carras Grand Resort, the most complete beachfront resort in Greece, lies within a breathtaking natural environment of 1,763 hectares and 9km of sandy, Blue-Flag awarded beaches and 25 pristine coves, where you can sense the powerful vibe of nature’s beauty mixed with Porto Carras’ iconic hospitality service. The resort features a Marina, Golf, Casino, Winery, Thalassotherapy-Spa, Tennis Courts, Horse-riding, Diving Academy and other exciting sports activities. Easily accessible, on a magnificent beachfront location with spectacular golden beaches and crystal-clear waters, Porto Carras offers a unique variety of exciting outdoor activities, spacious suites and in-room services for extra privacy as well as ample space to unwind and enjoy carefree holiday moments. The ideal space for complete privacy and relaxation, with secure outdoor facilities and high-quality services.

When you book a room or event at one of our 7 luxury hotels in Greece, your needs will be met and your expectations exceeded. With an atmosphere of refinement, comfort, and hospitality in every one of our offerings, we create something that discerning travelers have been enjoying for decades – a true home away from home. We welcome you to the 1st legacy hospitality business in Greece, we welcome you home.

Name: H Hotels Collection

Name: Lido Hotel
HQ Location: Greece, Peloponnese, Kórinthos, Melissi Xylokastro Old National Road Xylokastro, 20400
Company description: Lido Hotel is situated in the prefecture of Korinthia - Peloponnese and built on the seaside of the picturesque traditional village Melissi just 110km away from the city of Athens. Dedicated beach & swimming pool, restaurant focused on Greek cuisine with high quality local ingredients , all in a friendly and easy going setting mated with high standard service. We consider the hotel's location as special because it combines the sea and the mountain and gives you the opportunity to choose among various day excursions and activities. It is an ideal starting line for a short hop to famous sights such as Ancient Corinthus (Corinth), the Corinthus (Corinth) canal, Epidaurus (Epidavros), Mycenae (Mikinae), Delfi or places of extreme natural beauty such as Ziria, Trikala, Feneos etc. An ideal resort for families, and for those who prefer independent holidays out of the mass tourism industry.

Name: Domes Of Elounda Autograph Collection
Company description: Domes of Elounda, Autograph Collection is a 5 Star All Suites And Villas Spa Resort in Elounda, Crete, part of Ledra Hotels and Villas. Consisting solely of unique design suites and villas, Domes of Elounda, Autograph Collection offers guests the true Mediterranean experience, connecting luxury to natural environment and local culture. The resort introduces a new concept, holistically capturing the essence of all that is Mediterranean and bringing it to life in the form of a luxury resort.  This is a new luxury one isn’t afraid to touch, one you can live in, and one with extraordinary character that allows you to remain in sync with the landscape of Greece while enjoying world class accommodation. The attraction to the sea and vibrant culture of Crete has naturally created a feel that blends the magic of the Mediterranean with an alternatively traditional, yet human luxury. Each suite and villa finds its roots in architecture from Greece, Carpath and Syria, borrowing features such as domed and pyramidal ceilings that cool rooms capturing sea breezes, and create a new architecture of organically shaped living spaces at a human scale. The new Domes Luxury Residences, along with the stunning Domes Ultraluxe Villas, come with the “Haute Living Selection,” essentially creating an exclusive haute-luxury villa boutique experience, within the already impressive resort of Domes of Elounda, Autograph Collection.  Breathtaking views of the sea and the UNESCO protected castle on the islet of Spinalonga are part of this new design inviting the senses to feast on sights, scents and tastes from the rich outdoors through large windows, and spacious verandas.  Domes of Elounda Invites guests to immerse theirselves in the pageantry of one of the world’s most vibrant cultures, that of Crete.

Name: Atrium Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Atrium Hotels & Resorts is a collection of 5* Luxury Hotel Resorts situated on the island of sun; Rhodes, Greece. Privately owned and well established, the Atrium Luxury Collection offers guests the perfect escape for relaxing holidays, combining innovative architecture, state of the art facilities, personalised service, exclusive décor and the traditional warmth of Greek hospitality. Atrium Hotels & Resorts continues to expand and improve year on year, consistently striving to exceed our guests’ expectations and raise the bar in standards of luxury accommodation.

Name: Athens Ledra Hotel
Company description: With a spectacular view overlooking the Acropolis, the Athens Ledra Hotel is just minutes from a visit to Plaka, Piraeus Port and the New Acropolis museum using our hotel shuttle bus.  From our hotel in central Athens, you can stroll the winding streets of Plaka to the city's famous cafes and shops. Among hotels in Athens, we are the only to offer spacious double-double accommodations that include mini-bars, safes, individual climate controls, broadband Internet and luxury bedding in all types of rooms.  Enjoy great amenities at our Athens hotel - take a dip and enjoy the Acropolis view from our seasonal rooftop pool, stay fit at our 24-hour fitness area, or relax with a cocktail while listening to live music in our on-site lounge. After meetings or sightseeing, enjoy the ambience of Crystal Restaurant and bar that takes you to the sounds of Italy and the Mediterranean. Murano Crystal lingering, wooden floors and the white marble provide you with an airy atmosphere to relax and unwind to fine Italian cuisine. Enjoy lunch or dinner with friends or business partners where you can relish on an all-day menu inspired to offer you Italian and Mediterranean tastes.  On Sundays spoil your friends and family to a special menu of traditional tapas and meze complimented by a rich choice of dishes and desserts accompanied by live entertainment. Our bar offers from a wide selection of hot and cold beverages and cocktails.  Full American buffet breakfast at "Zephyros" Restaurant or indulge in Polynesian cuisine and fresh sushi at "Ledra Kai". When planning a business or social event, the Athens Ledra hotel creates magical moments indoors and on our rooftop terrace. For more information: www.athensledrahotel.com Sign up for our Linkedin Group: Friends of Athens Ledra Hotel and stay informed about Athens and our hotel.

These properties combine bold design, responsible living, and authentic experiences, immersing visitors in the genuine essence of Greece. Phāea is expanding its portfolio, introducing travelers to undiscovered Greek destinations while redefining immersive and authentic luxury travel.  OUR VALUES Consciousness. Innovation. Community.  OUR PEOPLE  Our organization is defined by the same qualities that characterize our people: authenticity and talent; optimism and attention to detail; generosity and consciousness; a mindset that embraces innovation and the love of learning. Our united team of like-minded people has built a culture that is inclusive and welcoming; one where everyone belongs. Together, we're on a journey of learning and evolution, where every day is an opportunity to develop new skills, to embrace new experiences, and to take another step forward towards our vision of an altogether kinder hospitality. Name: HotelBrain Group
Company description: HotelBrain Group is a leading hospitality group with regional presence in Greece and Southeastern Europe. It is the leading entity behind a selection of services within the hospitality industry and it comprises three distinct divisions. HotelBrain Hotels & Resorts is the largest hotelier in Greece, owning over 100 hotels across 36 destinations in Greece and Cyprus. Its portfolio of assets and destinations is diverse, enabling HotelBrain to become an emblematic choice for holidays in Greece. From luxury to economy, from city breaks to seascapes, HotelBrain hotels are both prolific and varied. HotelBrain Management provides hospitality management and advisory services, empowering hotels to achieve operational excellence and growth. HotelBrain Academy is a certified lifelong learning center, offering educational programs aimed at enhancing the skills of hospitality and tourism professionals.

Name: Metaxa Hospitality Group
Company description: Celebrating 50 years of continued market presence in 2025, Metaxa Hospitality Group is a leading and multi-awarded Greek group of luxury resorts and 5-star hotels. The Group offers authentic, high-quality experiences to its guests, while owning and operating over 1,100 rooms and suites in Crete (Creta Maris Resort, TUI Magic Life Candia Maris) and Santorini (Santo Collection Resort & Villas). Metaxa Hospitality Group, founded in 1975 by Nikolaos Metaxas, drove the transformation of Crete into a luxurious travel destination, embracing local hospitality, sustainability and culture with the emblematic Creta Maris Beach Resort, the first-ever 5-star, all-inclusive hotel of the island. Led by Andreas N. Metaxas into a new era of business growth and innovation, Metaxa Hospitality Group is an internationally acclaimed leader in sustainable hospitality. While implementing a long-term and ambitious ESG agenda, the Group fosters the growth of its 1,000 employees, elevates its guests’ authentic hospitality experiences and takes pioneering initiatives to regenerate the environment, create new value chains and support the local communities.

Esperia Group today owns ten hotels in Rhodes, six of which are located on the east coast of the island in Kallithea and four in Rhodes town. With dedication and flexibility to changing times and tourism needs and requirements ESPERIA HOTELS is developing in a modern tourism environment with a series of hotels each with different characters and identities that cater to all visitors of Rhodes in the best possible way. ESPERIA HOTELS facilities are constantly renovated, the services are always upgrading and the staff distinguishes for its kindness, and dedication to welcoming and hosting our  visitors. The philosophy of the company from its inception until today, features: -the pioneering investments -the flexibility and adaptation to the requirements of every tourist market -the promotion and enhancement of the local elements and products -the respect for people -the investment in local workforce -the emphasis on segregation and identity of each hotel unit -the pricing policy (value for money) The large number of repeat customers, the excellent relationships with major European tour operators, the awards and distinctions mark the recognition of the philosophy of Esperia Group from our customers and partners.

Name: Blu Collection

Company description: LINDOS MARE, Seaside Hotel Built into hillside terraces with panoramic views over beautiful Vlicha Bay,  just 2,5 km. away from the picturesque village of Lindos. A series of lifts, including a cable car, link the hotel to the beach. Undoubtedly one of Rhodes’ most treasured retreats, the elegant Lindos Mare is a place to unwind to the slow rhythm of island life. Recent renovations to all areas, together with impeccable service and excellent cuisine, create an atmosphere of discrete luxury and tranquillity in which to enjoy the perfect relaxing holiday.    LINDOS BLU, Luxury Hotel & Suites Built like a hillside amphitheatre overlooking the picturesque Vlicha Bay, this numerous awards winning Hotel is a peaceful retreat promising complete pampering and relaxation on the cosmopolitan island of Rhodes. The sophisticated hideaway, a proud member of Small Luxury Hotels, has a series of terraces that lead down to a sandy beach, villas and maisonettes with private pools, two outstanding restaurants, a penthouse sun-terrace, indoor and outdoor pools and an indulgent Spa. Situated right in the heart of Vlicha Beach, just outside the charming town of Lindos, the hotel is an ideal outpost for sun-seeking and a great starting point to explore the diversified landscape of the island of Rhodes. With 37 bedrooms, a swimming pool and poolside veranda, a beach restaurant and a vivid eco garden, Lindos Aqua Terra is a place made for leisure and comfort. Heavenly views of the Aegean Sea or breathtaking mountain scenery, coupled with excellent dining options and a splendid beach area, set the scene for the most amazing days of your summer.

The facilities offered in our hotels, along with the services assured by our well trained personnel, will give you the experience of Airotel’s hospitality, what we also like to call:  “Your home away from home”.

Name: Blue Bay Hotel
Company description: Within 250 metres from Skala Port in Patmos, Blue Bay is a 2 star Hotel that features a bar and a seafront sun terrace. It offers a 24-hour front desk, free Wi-Fi in all areas and rooms with views over the Aegean Sea or the garden. Opening to a balcony, the air-conditioned rooms of Blue Bay are equipped with a TV, a fridge and a telephone. Each unit includes a private bathroom with shower. An electric kettle, a tea/coffee maker and a hair-dryer are also available upon request. Guests can start their day with a buffet breakfast served daily at the dining area. Coffees and drinks can also be enjoyed at the on-site bar throughout the day. Restaurants and bars are within a short walk. The scenic town of Patmos and the famous Monastery of St John is at 5 km. Agrio Livadi Beach is 3.5 km away. Free public parking can be found nearby.

Name: Canaves Collection
Company description: The story of Canaves Collection begins in 1983 when the Chaidemenos family were among the first families to introduce tourism to the fishing village of Oia in Santorini.  It was then that Yianni and Anna Chaidemenos transformed 17 th -century caves, once used to store wine, into designer-chic luxury hotel rooms. The birth of the Canaves brand led to hotel’s all-white minimalistic concept, which redefined the meaning of luxury accommodation in Santorini.  High on the cliffs of Santorini, facing the ancient caldera, Canaves Collection Properties redefine hospitality as you know it. Welcome to Canaves Ena, Canaves Oia Suites, Canaves Sunday, Canaves Elefas Villas and Canaves Epitome.   From its inception, the theme of Canaves Collection has remained the same: to deliver unrivaled luxury experiences to guests so they can enjoy Santorini at it's best, all in one spot.

Name: Danai Beach Resort & Villas
Company description: The Danai Beach Resort & Villas, a splendid Greek hotel and member of “The Leading Hotels of the World”. Our luxurious hideaway is set within breathtaking nature: lush Mediterranean gardens and a wide- ranging, sandy beach. We offer a broad range of suites and villas of exceptional grace, unique in style and design, featuring either stunning views over the gardens, or the Aegean Sea. At Danai, we offer the qunitessence of Greek "Filoxenia" - truly heartfelt Hospitality beyond the norms of Hotelservices.

Name: Aria Hotels
HQ Location: Greece, Attica, Athens, Leoforos Vasilissis Amalias
Company description: Aria Hotels is a family-owned boutique hotel and villas company that offers holidaymakers authentic hospitality experiences and the ultimate in simple, effortless charm. The company has numerous hotels and villas in exceptional destinations of unique natural beauty throughout Greece: Athens, Cyclades, Crete, Epirus and the Peloponnese. Following the recent establishment of Aria Hotels in Spain, guests will soon be able to sample a new flavour of authentic hospitality. All Aria locations are chosen to appeal to discerning travelers looking for a secret hideaway.

Name: Anatolia Hospitality
Company description: "Anatolia Hospitality" is a Greek family owned company with a stellar reputation drawing on the extensive experience & know-how of three generations. Having started in the hotel business in Komotini, Greece, in 1930, the Chrysochoidis family has grown a successful brand that owns two city hotels, villas and luxury apartments in Cyclades and Ionian Sea and an incoming travel agency ASIT. The aim of the group is development through new management contracts, the creation of a network of franchises and new owned or leased hotels or villas. Whether you are new to the hospitality business and want to acquire a property, or thinking of rebranding your existing hotel we will assist you every step of the way.  Anatolia Hospitality follows the philosophy developed by the experience & passion of years to create a new concept in Greek hospitality with trend-setting concepts, chic design elements combined with signature service and personalized hospitality. We would like to welcome you to discover our new philosophy and be part of our successful winning team.

Name: Bill&Coo Mykonos
Company description: Bill&Coo is a true Mykonos original. Intimate in scale, laidback in spirit, timeless yet always current.  From sensational sunset cocktails at our flagship resort just outside Mykonos town to barefoot lunches at our secluded beach club, the Bill&Coo way of life is a heady cocktail of recreation and relaxation. Collaborations with world-renowned brands such as Valmont and Beefbar, partnerships with award-winning chefs and sommeliers, and a concierge service second to none. Bill&Coo offers a genuine and unpretentious approach to five-star hospitality.

Name: Elounda Collection Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Discover the Elounda Collection, where three luxurious properties redefine elegance in the stunning landscape of Elounda, Crete. Known for its breathtaking views and world-class service, this destination is your gateway to Greece’s finest luxury escapes. Indulge in unparalleled comfort and create unforgettable memories in paradise! 🌟 Elounda Peninsula: Europe’s sole waterfront hotel with luxurious private pool suites and villas. 🌟 Porto Elounda: Crete’s only golf and spa resort, offering unique and innovative experiences. 🌟 Elounda Mare: The island’s only Relais & Châteaux hotel, where luxury and charm unite in perfect harmony

Name: Hilton Athens
HQ Location: Greece, Attica, Athens, 46 Vassilissis Sofias Avenue, 11528
Company description: Hilton Athens is not just a hotel. It’s a legacy in Athens. An architectural marvel, the Hilton Athens was built in 1963 and was fully renovated in 2003 to be able to cope with the next episode in its ever interesting life. The hotel boasts 506 spacious rooms and some of the best city views available.  If you often travel for business and seek personal service and quietness, choose a room on the Executive floor, where you can check-in at a private Front Desk and relax in the Executive Lounge which offers breakfast, snacks and drinks throughout the day. The hotel has 23 meeting rooms in total, the largest of which can host up to 1300 people. All venues have natural daylight and offer maximum flexibility for all types of events.  Hilton Athens features four restaurants and two bars among which Galaxy Bar & Restaurant, the favorite hangout of celebrities and citizens of the world.  In a romantic, inspiring setting of contemporary chic, savor a cocktail, enjoy the latest international music selected by the DJ and be transported by the exhilarating panoramic view of the Acropolis, Lycabettus and the city of Athens.  The hotel features the city’s largest outdoor pool with Oasis Pool Bar & Grill, which is the ultimate getaway from the summer heat and a favorite among VIPs. Last but not least, Hiltonia Spa invites you to discover a perfect sanctuary of relaxation and renewal offering an endless array of health and beauty treatments Facilities and Services: 	- Located in the center of Athens, footsteps to Metro station 	- Four restaurants and two bars 	- Spa          - Fitness center	          - Hair salon 	 	- Largest swimming pool in the center of Athens         - All rooms with balcony         - Meeting space for up to 1,300 delegates           - 23 meeting rooms with natural daylight         - Business Centre	         - Executive Lounge with Acropolis View         - Free Wi-Fi in all bars and restaurants  	- Facilities for disabled guests

Name: NJV Athens Plaza Hotel
HQ Location: Greece, Attica, Athens, 2 Vasileos Georgiou A', 10564
Company description: With 159 spacious elegant rooms and 21 luxurious suites, the NJV Athens Plaza offers affordable accommodation complimented by chic decorations, state-of-the-art amenities and splendid views on the Acropolis. Guests staying at our luxury hotel will benefit from a solid night's rest while enjoying a tranquil environment in the city center of Athens. Offering one of the best luxury accommodations in Athens, the NJV Athens Plaza provides a variety of room and suite types to suit all travel requirements. Choose your preferred type of accommodation, from Classic, Classic Business and Superior rooms, to Deluxe City View and Acropolis View Suites. A split-level Presidential Suite is available offering privacy, a dining area for 10 guests and stunning panoramic views of Athens and the Acropolis. Watch movies on the large satellite TV, surf the Internet with the available free Wi-Fi service and cool off in an air conditioned room or suite after a warm day in Athens. If you are looking for a luxury place to stay in Athens or the finest accommodation near the Acropolis, the NJV Athens Plaza Hotel is exactly what you are looking for.

Name: Hotel Grande Albergo Delle Rose - Casino Rodos
Company description: Enchanting and impressive, luxurious and glamorous, Grande Albergo delle Rose, Italian for “Grand Hotel of Roses”, began its glorious course through history on the 24th of May 1927. The Island of the Knights was acquiring one of its emblematic buildings, created “to exude sun and wave like the Aegean Sea”, and destined to become an historic landmark. Fully renovated in May 2002 by the famous Italian architects and designers Giuseppe Molinari and Nicoletta Demolli, the hotel reopened its doors to a discerning clientele, having retained all the splendour of its glorious past. Guests delight in distinctive luxury throughout every corner of the establishment, experiencing unmatched service from the moment they arrive until the moment they depart, taking with them treasured memories of an unforgettable stay.

Name: KIPRIOTIS HOTELS
Company description: Kipriotis Hotels is a family owned company founded in 1984 by George Kipriotis. With business activities including 5 hotel complexes in Kos and 1 in Rhodes as well as Kos International Convention Centre, George Kipriotis was pioneer in the development of the hospitality and tourism industry of the Dodecanese islands in Greece. From catering to high-profile pharmaceutical companies and world-class insurance firms to hosting small and medium-sized enterprises, the world-class Kipriotis International Convention Centre (KICC) and the Panorama Hotel & Suites Conference Centre have been behind the success of numerous events. These two venues – within the same complex of five hotels and a first-class fitness gym all within walking distance of each other – can jointly cater to as much as 7,000 people in 1540 rooms spreading in five hotels within walking distance from one to another Choose between: - Kipriotis Panorama Hotel & Suites - 5 stars - Kipriotis Village                                   - 4 stars - Kipriotis Hippocrates                         - 4 stars - Kipriotis Maris Suites                         - 5 stars - Kipriotis Panorama Aqualand          - 4 stars - Kipriotis Rhodes                                 - 3 stars

Name: Chandris Hotels
Company description: Chandris Hotels throughout Greece are proud to carry the famous Greek Tradition of Hospitality to all our guests in Athens, Thessaloniki and Chios. The three Chandris Hotels, Metropolitan Hotel,THE MET Hotel and Chios Chandris Hotel have long been noted for their traditional hospitality and impeccable service. For the past three years, a multimillion euro remodeling programme has endowed them with new concepts of quality, comfort and environmental awareness. Attractively arranged and furnished rooms, comfortable public areas, sensitively landscaped surroundings, flawless air conditioning, fire detection and prevention systems are the chief features of the Chandris Hotels Chain's remodelling programme. Its main aim is to continue to give our increasingly sophisticated International and Greek clientele the standard of service and accommodation they have come to expect.

Name: Olympic Palace Resort Hotel & Convention Center
Company description: Olympic Palace Resort Hotel & Convention Center stands out with its’ imposing circular architecture,contemporary and chic interior design as well as its’ first-class leisure facilities and attentive services. 343 beautifully appointed guest rooms and luxurious suites that spread over 8 floors have been stylishly renovated and equipped with modern amenities emphasizing on comfort and functionality as a priority while ensuring that the hotel caters to all needs of the most discerning travellers. Olympic Palace offers a fun and relaxing holiday environment with an extensive array of leisure & sports facilities, fine International cuisine, chic bars, daily activities, evening entertainment and above all genuine first-class service that will leave absolutely nothing to be desired. The resort is suitable for the physically challenged and wheelchair users.

Name: The Stanley
Company description: The Stanley is a 4 star hotel located directly in the city of Athens, Greece. Located on Karaiskaki Square, navigating Athens is made easy with the Metaxourghio Metro station at the hotel’s doorstep. The Stanley is located just a few stops from Syntagma, the ancient historical sights, and a short walk to some of the best restaurants and nightlife in Athens in the neighborhoods of Gazi and Keramikos.  Enjoy the rooftop terrace at The Stanley, the crown jewel of the hotel, complete with sweeping views of the Athenian skyline, Mount Lycabettus, and the Acropolis. Take a dip in the rooftop pool, or a drink and a snack at the open-air bar. At night dine at Virtus on the roof, serving both Greek and international favorites.  Wake up refreshed and with views of the Acropolis or Lycabettus in our clean and comfortable rooms complete with all amenities needed for a short city break or business trip.  Host small or large meetings in one of our 3 conference rooms, holding up to 200 guests. Or enjoy a corporate lunch or event in our 1st floor restaurant, holding up to 400 people.

Name: Gennadi Grand Resort
Company description: Official LinkedIn page of Gennadi Grand Resort

Name: Ikos Resorts
Company description: Founded in 2014, Ikos Resorts envision to redefine all-inclusive and create a personal holiday experience, introducing the “Infinite Lifestyle” concept. Where elegance, authenticity and distinctive services, underpinned by personal care and seamless service, come in one “all-included” price.  As one of the largest hospitality groups in Greece, we aim to grow our operations in the entire Mediterranean, with a team that will soon include almost 4.000 professionals!  We are constantly looking to enforce our team with people from Greece and abroad who love working in Tourism and Hospitality and who will make our vision their own. If you are one of them, then we have room for you!

Name: Civitel Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Civitel Hotels & Resorts is a Greek Hotel Chain which was founded in 1964 and aims to offer excellent services in accommodation, dining and professional events. Our Group represent four properties – two in Athens and two in Crete – offering the very best of Greek hospitality combined with international standards. Our properties are the ideal choice for guests who travel for business or simply as leisure travelers, for a relaxing holiday or a shopping weekend. Our 300 rooms are at your disposal and come in a wide range, from standard, superior and executive to junior suites and bungalows. All room types have been recently renovated or refurbished so that they can provide a serene, comfortable and welcoming accommodation, combining frugality and luxury decoration and services, which meet any personal need or business demand. Every hotel’s dining venue offers fine Greek and international cuisine through rich and refined menus as well as domestic and foreign wines, perfectly pairing with our dishes. Our mission is simple – to provide our guests with a feeling of comfort and elegance. Each one of our guests is a unique case for us & always at the center of our attention!

Name: EUROTEL Group
Company description: With over 35 years of experience, we’ve been a trusted partner to the hospitality, F&B, and wellness industries—delivering integrated technology & infrastructure solutions, strategic services and human-centered innovation.  Through Eurotel Hospitality in Greece & Cyprus, LeaderIT & Eminence —we support hospitality & wellness businesses at every stage of development.  - Eurotel Hospitality  Our flagship company and a leader in hospitality and wellness operations technology. As a certified Oracle partner & exclusive representative of Vingcard|ASSA ABLOY, we deliver and support advanced systems such as PMS, POS, and smart access control, helping businesses streamline operations and elevate the guest experience. We also develop proprietary platforms like Afrodite Spa Software, tailored to the unique needs of the industry.  - LeaderIT  We provide integrated Information, Communications & Security technology solutions that power modern businesses. From infrastructure and networks to data security and systems integration, we enable businesses to scale, evolve and stay secure in a digital-first world.  - Eminence Hospitality As the strategic advisory pillar of our Group, Eminence designs and guides future-ready hospitality & wellness concepts. We provide services across concept development, spatial planning, ICT strategy, spa operations and project management—ensuring distinctive guest experiences with operational clarity and long-term value.  What sets us apart  • 30+ years of dedicated experience in hospitality and wellness  • A unique blend of consulting, infrastructure & digital solutions  • End-to-end support across the full lifecycle  • Deep specialization-global partnerships with a strong understanding of local needs  • A people-first culture, with empathy, trust, and collaboration  • Long-standing client relationships shaped by respect & shared goals At Eurotel Group, we don’t implement systems—we build value, empower people, and shape experiences that matter.

Name: The Royal Blue
Company description: The Royal Blue 5* luxury beach resort, is an exclusive resort on the northern coast of the island of Crete that allows you to lose yourself in authentic luxury & quiet sophistication. With its own private bay, a man made marina and an endless horizon of Cretan Blue, where the sea meets the sky in a harmonious kaleidoscope, you will find your getaway to an unparallel sensorial journey.   The Luxury Resort consists of numerous public and private swimming pools as well as colorful gardens which extend throughout the resort fulfilling the senses with a unique blend of well-being and relaxation. Natural stone has been used extensively with dedicated passion for detail, in the decoration of all outdoor areas, thus creating the perfect mix between sophistication and natural elegance.

Name: Glyfada Riviera Hotel
Company description: Totally renovated! City Resort!

Name: Domes Noruz Chania Autograph Collection Crete
HQ Location: Greece, Crete, 5 Strati Pantelaki Str. Agioi Apostoloi
Company description: Domes Noruz Chania is a beachfront boutique hotel with only 83 accommodations focusing in personalized services and tailor made experiences.  Domes Noruz offers a new take on lifestyle luxury property in western Crete. By embracing the past and the present of the city and by adding current hospitality trends into the mix, it offers a fresh, contemporary way for design-savvy guests to explore this popular destination and enjoy it differently. We see ourselves not only as hosts but as curators. We want our guests to see Chania from a different perspective, ours. We constantly mix the best of what the area has to offer with our own, modern view about life and how holidays should be. We embrace the past and the present of Chania and we add a well-researched touch of innovation. We are curious about the world, we love exploring destinations through the eyes of the locals.

Name: Cronwell Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Cronwell Hotels & Resorts manages and owns hospitality venues of different type in Europe and Russia.  In Greece Cronwell operates Cronwell Platamon Resort, Cronwell Resort Sermilia, Rahoni Cronwell Park Hotel Adults Only.

Name: THE DOLLI
Company description: Welcome to The Dolli! Gazing at the Parthenon, few steps away from the Acropolis & in front of the historical Plaka neighbourhood. An one-of-a-kind view of the ancient world. A historical 1925 mansion, designed by Andreas Kriezis, one of the brilliant greek classical architects is reimagined today as a contemporary hôtel du luxe.  Encapsulating a strong sense of heritage, the original essence of greek hospitality and the incomparable vibrant energy in the heart of Athens. 46 luxurious bedrooms, pied à terres & apartments privés bathed in athenian light. The rooftop is a unique pièce de résistance with stunning views, a members only pool and the exclusive haven, Dolli's Restaurant.

Name: Rocabella Santorini Hotel & SPA
Company description: Welcome to Rocabella Santorini - your bohemian retreat, where slow living and happiness is homemade. A place where you can be your true self, authentic and simple. On an island of unique beauty begins your experience of an accommodation refined down to the smallest detail. Discover the landscapes, the flavors, the magic of Santorini as afforded by Rocabella Santorini’s brand-new concept of hospitality. Rocabella is a spread of 11,000 square meters in the picturesque village of Imerovigli. Enjoying a scenic setting in Imerovigli, Santorini, Rocabella Resort combines traditional architecture with modern design. Boasting magnificent views over the caldera, it offers a pool, a wellness centre and fine dining. Our people welcome guests with genuine warmth, making you feel instantly “at home”. The hotel offers a range of facilities and services that makes your stay a cherished holiday or an unforgettable honeymoon. Lifestyle and Entertainment Brands: Afropsaro Restaurant  Anedosa Spa Rocabella Weddings M|Y Omega II & Fiji Yacht cruises

Name: The Royal Senses Curio Collection By Hilton
Company description: 5* Luxury Resort Joyful Togetherness. The Royal Senses, Curio Collection by Hilton is the perfect natural sanctuary for families, kinfolks and friends who want to celebrate togetherness. Throughout the resort, indoor and outdoor spaces are designed for joyous gatherings. Naturally, togetherness is balanced with quiet relaxation at The Royal Senses: Access to ample calm spots – including private beaches, private pools and spacious hotel rooms – provide intimate alone-time.  The Royal Senses celebrates a passionate joy of life, letting guests feel a vivid sense of community, in a natural yet elegantly designed environment that draws from the livelin;ess of Crete’s multifaceted culture! The resort at a glance: ✓Lively generous space ✓ 97 guestrooms & 81 suites ✓ Elevated views from the hilltop ✓ Access to private beach – sandy and rocky ✓ Pools are salted & some heated, with sun beds and  shades (74 private – 4 main – spa - sharing,  3 for children),  ✓ Activating Spa – (local) herbal therapies – products made by you ✓ Marketplace (the center of communal  life at the resort, with  pop-up shops of Cretan/Greek restaurants, souvlaki,  ouzo..) ✓ 1 main & 2 à-la-carte restaurant, 3 bars ✓ Farm with Cretan herbs ✓ Aqua Park - Kids Club

Name: SECRET HOTELS
Company description: Secret Hotels brought to create an experience that will go above and beyond, guests’ preferences in luxury hospitality, offering unprecedented excellence in its standards and elegance while remaining authentic to local traditions. Secret Hotels started in 2014 with Santorini Secret Suites & Spa, a 5-star boutique hotel, a member of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World and Traveller Made, which is also the group’s flagship. Now, the group owns five hotels in Santorini, four of which are located in Oia and one in the traditional village of Foinikia. All hotels are characterized by their luxury and combine accommodation with personalized services, high level gastronomy, and authentic signature experiences.

Name: Fodele Beach & Water Park Holiday Resort
Company description: A care-free heaven waits 25 km west of Heraklion Airport. Carved into the cliffside, overlooking the sea, sits Fodele Beach & Water Park Resort.  Island bungalows rise next to beautiful gardens. 412 guestrooms reflect centuries of style and culture. With the beach at your feet, vivid views all around, you’ll feel at home as soon as you arrive. Relax with a full body massage or stress-reducing treatment. Dig into unforgettable dining experiences inspired by the world’s great culinary capitals. See the scenery on two wheels or let time fly by on the basketball, tennis and archery courts. While you're at it, why not chill under our gazebos with a cocktail in hand or kick up your feet on our Balinese beach beds? You can also enjoy the gym, scuba club, three swimming pools and recreational sports at your leisure.  And don’t miss our water park for the wettest and wildest thrills in Crete. With slides, rides, kids' animation, a windmill snack bar and 950 sq. m. of dazzling pools, you won't find a hotel water park this big anywhere else in the region. An island, a hotel, a paradise for families, couples and young guests alike, yet Fodele Beach is so much more. It’s an all-in water park wonderland, a world away from the ordinary.

Name: Astir Odysseus Kos Resort & Spa
Company description: Astir Odysseus Resort & Spa is a premier 5-star luxury hotel located in the picturesque Tingaki area of Kos, Greece. The resort has been a top choice for travelers seeking elegance, comfort, and world-class hospitality. Astir Odysseus offers a seamless blend of modern sophistication and authentic Greek charm. Our resort features state-of-the-art facilities, including exquisite accommodations, fine dining restaurants, a rejuvenating spa, and stunning beachfront views. With a commitment to exceptional high quality service and attention to detail, we create unforgettable experiences for guests from around the world. Whether for a relaxing getaway, a romantic escape, or a family vacation, Astir Odysseus Resort & Spa delivers the perfect balance of luxury, tranquility, and warm Greek hospitality.

Name: F Zeen Retreats
HQ Location: Greece, Kefalonia, Lourdas Beach Road Livathos, 28083
Company description: F Zeen Retreats opened its doors in 2015. A family-run luxury brand with a focus on wellbeing and nature. The inspiration came from wanting to create something that incorporated the family's passions and interests as well as reflecting their diverse cultural background. F Zeen Retreats started an adults-only wellness retreat nestled on the pristine shores of Kefalonia island in the Ionian Sea. Embracing the slow life, this hotel is a sanctuary of tranquility designed to deliver a meaningful experience. The brand has started to expand into Athens and more destinations within Greece will follow, opening up new and exciting career opportunities for members of F Zeen Retreats. We understand the importance of creating an inspiring and good place to work for our employees with room each member's growth and development.

Name: Mystique A Luxury Collection Hotel
Company description: Carved into the rugged Caldera cliffs, Mystique, a Luxury Collection Hotel, overlooks the turquoise expanse of the Aegean Sea that encircles the island of Santorini. Designed using Cycladic architecture, where gentle curves and sculpted arches blend with a muted color palette and light enhancing spaces, the hotel is a secluded hideaway that offers gloriously open horizons, in a stunning and legendary location, placed just 18km from Santorini airport. Such a unique setting provides a tranquil and discreet quality that defines the hotel’s character. A favored destination for honeymoons and romantic escapes, Mystique emanates a carefree spirit, imparting an understated, exclusive feel, so reminiscent of the spectacular location. Linked by a network of cobbled pathways, all 39 suites and villas boast panoramic sea views across to the active volcano that has shaped this exceptional island. Designed to generate space and light into each guest room, the interiors are a combination of traditional regional charm, with a contemporary twist and up-to-the-minute technology.  Furnishings are an exploration of natural untamed materials, providing an interesting contrast against the textured walls and linen fabrics that add an air of elegant simplicity.

Name: Grand Hotel Palace | Thessaloniki
Company description: Grand Hotel Palace, a 5 star conference hotel is located at the west entrance of Thessaloniki, just two and a half kilometres from the city centre.  Τhe traditional warm hospitality and the aristocratic atmosphere offer a unique experience. The building with a U-shaped floor plan, inspired by the architecture of gorgeous aristocratic neoclassical buildings, creates an environment of absolute elegance. The hotel is consisting of 219 rooms and 24 Grand, Deluxe, Junior and Classic suites.  Ideal for your business trips or your excursions in Thessaloniki. The deluxe rooms of Grand Hotel Palace, offer a comfortable and relaxing stay and provide an exquisite accommodation of high aesthetics and luxurious services. They have been redesigned, combining neoclassical lines with the latest trends in architecture and design. The bathroom of the deluxe rooms gives you the ultimate sense of relaxation and rejuvenation through a careful selection of materials and colors.

Name: THE MODERNIST
Company description: The Modernist is a lifestyle hospitality brand that inspires curiosity and authentic experiences, deeply rooted in its local communities and dedicated to a more open, ethical, and sustainable future.

Name: Rodos Palladium Leisure & Wellness
Company description: Rodos Palladium Leisure & Wellness, the island's most awarded 5 star hotel, harmonically combines discrete luxury and authentic quality. Uniquely situated on an area of 30,000 sqm, it enjoys a premier beach front location, right on the Blue Flag awarded sandy & pebble beach of Kallithea. The hotel is in close proximity both to the City of Rhodes (8 km) with its splendid Medieval Town and its famous historical sites, as well as to the island's places of natural beauty. Rodos Palladium is renowned for its exceptional service, elegant restaurants with fine Greek & Mediterranean cuisine, relaxing bars, and large tropical pools. The hotel's spa center offers a wide range of Thalgo relaxation and beauty treatments - the renowned French name in the world of marine treatment.

Name: Domes Aulūs Elounda Curio Collection By Hilton
Company description: With Mediterranean-inspired interior design, direct access to the sea and stunning views of the Mirabello gulf and UNESCO protected island of Spinalonga, Domes Aulūs Elounda is a renowned adults-only hotel located on the tranquil island of Crete. It is the ideal spot for a rejuvenating break in the sun with extensive views and ample natural light that create the perfect escape from reality.

Name: Avra Collection
Company description: Placing guests at the center of our core values, the ambition of Avra Collection is to provide our guests an exceptional and personalized experience offering remarkable, world class services in the finest surroundings. Combining the philosophy and warmth of traditional Greek hospitality with our people’s strong work ethic, ideals and integrity, we aim at offering only experiences of excellent quality. Our main qualities and characteristics at a glance: SAVVY HOTELIERS BESPOKE DESIGN MEMORABLE STAY Following the principles of innovation, inspiration and motivation we provide sophisticated, stylish and effortlessly luxurious accommodations and environs, always ensuring that our people deliver only the warmest and most authentic experience, embodying both the local culture and our corporate culture. Always striving for excellence, we know that together we can always achieve more, thus we concentrate all our efforts to actively interact with the world around us, passing on our core values and philosophy not only to our valuable teams behind closed doors, but also to our cherished guests enriching their whole experience.

Name: Kassandra Palace Seaside Resort
Company description: Covering 70,000 sq. m. of Macedonian land in the region of Kriopigi, this 5-star hotel in Halkidiki enamors guests with its majestic surroundings, the amazing views to the shimmering Aegean Sea as well as the high-end facilities and exceptional services offered. Focusing on the well-being of every individual this family-friendly hotel in Halkidiki masterfully combines discreet luxury and comfort with attention to detail and attentive service ensuring a holiday beyond your imagination.

Name: Mykonos Grand Hotel & Resort
Company description: Dazzling whitewashed, cube-shaped buildings and cobbled paths set against the backdrop of a deep blue sea and sky, Mykonos Grand Hotel and Resort has a superb beachfront location barely three miles from Mykonos town. Opposite is the sacred island of Delos, said to be one of the sunniest areas in the world – and, according to Greek mythology, the birthplace of Apollo. All around is the island’s natural beauty: picturesque stretches of sand, crystalline seas, azure-blue skies and an earthen-colored landscape bathed in the unique Aegean light. Scattered across an extensive five acres to provide space and privacy, the 96 generously-sized rooms and suites are decorated in bright white with splashes of blue some with private pools. Furniture and decorative lighting is elegant and streamlined, recalling mid-twentieth century styling.   This stylish and restful enclave has a wonderfully pampering spa where Greek inspired massages can be held in cabanas by the sea, a beautiful 500sqm pool and a spectacular outdoor amphitheater for social events and exercise classes. The hotel’s gourmet Dolphins of Delos Restaurant is a dramatic open air dining experience with stunning views. While the Aqua e Sole Restaurant has a tranquil poolside location. Other resort’s facilities include tennis and squash courts and a Technogym fitness center.

Name: Pilot Resorts
Company description: Born from passion, honed by experience, and driven by innovation, we are a family-owned group home to three distinctive luxury resorts in Western Crete—ÓROS Resort, Pilot Beach, and Pilot Amphora—each a beacon of comfort and genuine Greek hospitality on the charming west coast of Crete. Our journey began in the early 90s with a pioneering spirit that laid the foundations not only for our resorts but for the region itself as a hub for exceptional and authentic Cretan hospitality. Today, guided by our unwavering values of hospitality, sustainability, and social responsibility, we continue to honour the beauty, heritage, and culture of Crete, giving back through conscious initiatives that protect the land and support the local community. Our commitment extends beyond luxury—we remain deeply devoted to our people, our environment, and the timeless essence of Philoxenia, where warm welcomes and effortless discreet service make every guest feel at home, in their own perfect retreat. With thoughtful attention to detail, we create a setting where every meaningful occasion is embraced with care. From the exclusive ÓROS Luxury Beach Resort, a sanctuary of refined indulgence overlooking the ceaseless blue horizon, to the renowned Pilot Beach Resort, where Cretan tradition meets five-star leisure, and Pilot Amphora, a timeless retreat inspired by the island’s rich heritage, we go beyond luxury to create life lasting moments. More than destinations, our resorts are places where memories are made, pampering every sense, amplifying every feeling and leaving an imprint that lingers long after departure.

Name: Lindian Village All-Inclusive Resort Rhodes Curio Collection By Hilton
Company description: Lindian Village Beach Resort Rhodes is opening its doors totally renovated, as Curio Collection by Hilton. The 5-star international beach-front hotel captures the energy and soul of the island and encourages escapists to match its calming pace through a wealth of services, emotions and experiences that artfully bring together nature, wellness and authenticity.

The complex of rooms have been traditionally hand-crafted to reflect the warmth and sophistication befitting the island. Name: A For Athens
Company description: Right next to Monastiraki Metro Station, A for Athens offers a rooftop bar with a stunning view of the Acropolis. Nightlife districts of Psirri, Monastiraki and Plaka are a 5-minute walk. The stylish rooms feature a modern bathroom, a flat-panel TV and designer furniture.  The large windows allow for plenty of sunlight and stunning city views, while some rooms face the Acropolis. Wi-Fi is free in the entire Property. Each of the 35 rooms is comfortable and elegantly designed, with a contemporary greek twist and an attention to detail. At A for Athens there are no extravagant luxuries, but you will get a view to the Acropolis even while you take your shower or ideas on places to visit while in your room. Guests can take their breakfast on the panoramic terrace with Acropolis views. The rooftop bar is open until the early morning hours serving refreshments and cocktails. A for Athens’ has a convenient location at the heart of the historic centre. On our top floor, we created an urban terrace, with the most stunning view to the Acropolis, Plaka and Monastiraki Square.  An ideal place to have your breakfast in the morning or enjoy our house special cocktails at night. Minimal design is set to enhance your viewing experience and our menu is created with special care, with emphasis on local and healthy ingredients. There is no other place to stay in Athens, where both the city’s attractions and main public transport are in walking distance. We are just above Monastiraki Square, next to the metro station – that will ease your transportation to and from the airport and Piraeus port- above the city’s busiest shopping street, next to Plaka and Psirri and 10 minutes walk to Syntagma and Gazi. From our wide view rooms and the top floor, you will have the most spectacular view to the Acropolis, with nothing to interrupt your viewing experience.

Name: President Hotel Athens
Company description: Set amidst the eternally intriguing urban landscape of Athens, the landmark building of President Hotel welcomes you, offering an elegant and comfortable stay. Strategically situated near two Metro stations and other means of public transport close to the heart of Athens, the hotel offers great access to renowned cultural landmarks, commercial streets, historic sites and entertainment attractions. Our warm hospitality, modern amenities and personalized services render us the perfect springboard to explore Athens’ charm.  Featuring a warm and family-friendly atmosphere for a restful stay, all rooms showcase an astonishing city view. Enjoy a refreshing drink at our relaxing lounge areas, or taste modern culinary delicacies at our restaurant. Find our signature cocktails at Penthouse 21 -situated on the 21st floor next to the pool area- complemented with a local treat, while gazing at the mesmerizing 360o view.   Known for its business-friendly environment and its tailor-made services, President Hotel curates all sorts of events. The contemporary conference rooms accommodate successfully your corporate events with a stylish edge. Name: Lesante Cape
Company description: Located in Akrotiri village, a privileged place of great historic cultural value, where the manors of the island’s noblemen used to be situated, with a beautiful, secluded beach in front and extraordinary views to the blue horizon, the Lesante Cape unveils a new, hospitality experience. Build as a traditional Greek village, with a square at its center -where all the socializing and events take place- with a café, a taverna, a few small shops all around it, a folklore museum and its own church nearby, the Lesante Cape is a modern -and very vivid- trip to the past. Everything around you, honours authenticity, starting from the traditional Zakynthian architecture, with the tall, proud arches, the large white stones and earthly tones embracing everything, to the wooden furniture and straw-made décor, all being brought to today, with contemporary amenities and services that accommodate your modern living. Explore a luxurious getaway to the traditional Zante, today!

The Athens Tiare Hotel offers a variety of room types and unique suites. Our newly redesigned guestrooms, suites and public spaces feature bold accent colors, custom furnishings, and state of the art technology. Through the selection of the guestrooms, visitors can enjoy the unique views combined with casual, luxury details of interior and living experience in one of the best hotels in Athens.

Name: Daios Luxury Living
Company description: Daios Luxury Living is an exclusive boutique hotel in the heart of Thessaloniki, Greece. Directly on the waterfront on Nikis Avenue, luxury rooms and suites with captivating sea views as well as contemporary conference meeting spaces make Daios Luxury Living ideal for business and leisure travellers alike. The city’s most famous landmarks - the White Tower, Aristotelous Square and the Helexpo Exhibition Centre - are a short walk from our location.  Daios Bar Restaurant, situated on the sea level of Daios Luxury Living, offers an upscale gastronomy experience with exceptional wine lists from the Greek vine and beyond. A favourite dining spot for locals and visitors to the city, the all day bar and restaurant is known for its outstanding service, friendly atmosphere and unique location. Our hospitality ethos and culture embolden us to constantly seek talented team members to join our multi-layered business in a diverse and inspirational environment. Working at Daios Luxury Living provides unlimited opportunities for challenging and exciting experiences with a view for progression in the future.

Name: Porto Angeli Beach Resort

With 40 years of experience in the hospitality industry, we hope to offer our guests a joyful escape and memorable stay.

Name: Ammon Zeus Luxury Beach Hotel

Along with it's contractors and third-party servicee providers, the Ammon Zeus team works to satisfy the customer and provide them with an unforgetable summer experience.

If you want to become part of our team, please visit our website: http://www.cleopatra-marina.gr/career/

Name: Archipelagos Hospitality World
Company description: We are a Mykonos-based Hospitality Group, brought to life by people with a different understanding of what luxury is.  We are inspired by the eclectic demands of a global audience that has been everywhere and has seen everything - and has decisively moved past the obvious.  From moment one of our inception, it was crystal-clear to us that there is a limit to what the mainstream understanding of luxury can offer.  Our core philosophy is that true luxury should whisper, rather than shout. We stand for accessing a deeper meaning through choices and pastimes. We celebrate big-small pleasures that are usually hidden in plain sight. We encourage the appreciation of every single moment, as we believe that time should be measured in emotions.  In this challenging but beautiful endeavor, our unmistakable Greek and Mykonian origin has defined us. Guided by a contemporary take on a hospitality tradition that spans millennia, we place the guest at the very center of everything that we think or do.  At the same time, the inimitable flair of our island and its unique view of what matters in life, colors all the experiences that we offer – aesthetic, culinary, nature-centered or lifestyle-driven.  This understanding of things shapes our propositions, past present and future.  We started from Archipelagos Hotel Mykonos, today a globally established resort and a proud member of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World.  As we expanded, we moved into the exclusive Archipelagos All Suites Mykonos, creating the perfect hideout in the way. Energized by the whole-hearted embrace of what we have to say, we have developed bold, exciting plans for the future.  Anything that our brand signs, has our unconventional luxury philosophy as a guiding light and our Greek-Mykonian roots as a source of precious inspiration. Archipelagos Hospitality Group Life, reimagined

We also know that you like your independence and freedom, so if you need us we are here 24/7 and when you do not, we respect your privacy. BlueVillas is with you every step of the way to the perfect Greek island vacation.

Name: Kinsterna Hotel
HQ Location: Greece, Attica, Athens, 13 Alexandras Av. & 1 Katsantoni St., 11473
Company description: The Kinsterna Hotel is a Byzantine mansion which has been faithfully and meticulously restored with great respect for its long history. Winner of numerous international distinctions and awards, Kinsterna today is a true paradise for nature lovers. Words alone cannot describe the peace and quiet, the clean air and the majestic atmosphere of the mansion and its estate – all with a view of the legendary castle-rock of Monemvasia. The Kinsterna Hotel is located in the settlement of Agios Stephanos, 7 kilometres south-west of Monemvasia in the southern Peloponnese and is built on the edge of the “Ibrahim Bey estate”. Kinsterna’s owners have revived the traditional agricultural practices and occupations of the estate, such as: harvesting grapes, making olive oil, distilling tsipouro (traditional Greek spirits), baking bread and producing soap – creating a working model of sustainability that lies at the heart of their goal to make the estate as autonomous and self-sufficient as possible - as it was centuries ago. Enjoy the delicious local specialties prepared by our chef and his team; relax by the sparkling pools filled with fresh water from mountain springs; browse rare volumes in the estate library; sample the wines from our own cellar; revitalize your senses at the atmospheric Kinsterna Spa, or hike through the verdant hills surrounding the estate, and enjoy majestic views and the beauties of nature. Kinsterna also organizes historical, cultural and athletic events and activities, which are intimately connected to the estate and specially designed for visitors who wish to learn more about the mansion’s region and history.

In ancient times, “φιλοξενία” (philoxenia) was considered a moral duty of any Greek towards the Gods.  This word derives from the verb “φιλώ” which in ancient Greek language means “love”, and the noun “ξένος” (guest).  Therefore, philoxenia means love for guests.  In general, in ancient times  a guest was considered a respectable and sacred person and due to that, whoever broke the rules of philoxenia was severely punished by the Olympian Gods.  The basic responsibilities of the owner of the house was to receive and behave properly to the guests, offer food, accommodation, bath and treat them with farewell gifts so that their bonding will become even stronger. The purpose of Divine Hotels group is to always offer inviting and inspiring places to all travelers. Our hotel offers 27 rooms with a capacity of 68 beds. It belongs to the second category of 3 star hotels and it is found on the edge of the village in a proprietary space of 7 lush hectares. It is 160km away from Athens, 50 km from Patra and just 12km from Aigio. Kalvryta and the ski resort of the Helms are at a distance of 39km and 54km respectively. If relaxation, rest as well as being in touch with nature constitute as a main prerequisite of your expeditions then our hotel surrounded by olive groves and orange groves, far away from every central or main road and noise that bothers you, offers the security of a big enclosed garden, as well as the hospitable atmosphere of its spaces, for a pleasant stay and rest, for you and your family.  Walk to one of the most beautiful beaches of Peloponnese to enjoy the sun and the sea or simply relax by the pool of our hotel and enjoy your drinks at the pool bar. Let this be the starting point of your outings toward nearby Kalavryta via car or with Odontotos railway. Organise an excursion and a visit to the most renowned archaeological sites of Southern Greece such as Delphi, Ancient Olympia, Ancient Corinth, the Mycenae of ancient Epidaurus and the archaeological sites and museums of Athens. If you like hiking, then take advantage of the possibility to walk a bit of the European path E4 that passes by our village and crosses the beautiful ravine of the Vouraiko river or one of the many other choices that is offered by mountainous Achaia.   Are you a lover of cycling? Our area offers a variety of rides from that range from very easy courses up to expert mountainous ones. Our hotel with its warm family environment is waiting to offer its services to you.

Name: Your Butler
Company description: The idea of creating Butler hasn’t come to us overnight. Being previously involved with other cutting edge technology platform startups, traveling was an important part of our work.  It was during these travels that we first handedly witnessed the inefficiencies of the current operational status quo of the hotel business.  Inefficiencies that were mainly caused by the lack of integrated digital solutions in the industry.  Our drive was the fact that we knew we could address these gaps as we have done so in our previous similar endeavors.  Butler was formed in June 2018 in London UK.  Our initial action was to further research the market in order to establish the first intuitively perceived inadequacies and verify our claims.  After our research showed us, a greater than expected, number of areas which our solutions could be implemented, we formed our core engineering team from a pool of proven to us engineers.  The alpha release was ready in August 2018. We used this release in order to onboard our first initial strategic partners with which we managed to conduct feasibility studies and various PoCs. As of May 2019 Butler on-boarded a full team of engineers, based in Athens Greece, aiming to perfect the current beta version. Our sales team, based in London UK, had already established some key players as early partners and we aim to triple our clients.

Name: Rockwell Greece
Company description: About Us Rockwell is a leading company in the distribution, marketing, and special production of luxury kitchenware and tableware equipment, based in Greece. We exclusively distribute products from renowned manufacturers, including KAI Knives Japan, Sabatier French Knives, Laguiole, Claude Dozorme, Robert Welch, CRISTEL, De Buyer, AMT Gastroguss, Skeppshult, La Cuisine, Le Creuset, GEFU, GRAEF, Teakhauss, Legnoart, L’Atelier du Vin, Eisch Glassware, RONA Glassware, Pillivuyt Porcelain, and Seltmann Porcelain. Our History Founded in 1872 by Ioannis Pourikas in Elassona, Larissa, Rockwell started as a personal enterprise focused on manufacturing and trading cutting tools (scissors, knives, etc.) for both home and professional use. Initially, our clientele consisted mainly of livestock farmers and agriculturists from Thessaly, Western Macedonia, and Epirus. During the winter months, the manufacturing workshop was based in Elassona, while in the summer, it relocated to Samarina, Grevena. In 1922, Apostolos Ioannou Pourikas took over, maintaining high quality and expanding distribution throughout Greece. In 1965, Evangelos Apostolou Pourikas shifted the business to importing and distributing foreign brands, ending our production but continuing product repair. By 1992, Leonidas and Apostolos Pourikas modernised the business, focusing on retail and selective wholesale trade. In 1997, under the leadership of Leonidas Pourikas, Rockwell moved its operations to Athens, evolving into a uniquely high-quality enterprise in its field.  Today, Rockwell's quality is evident in both retail and wholesale markets across Greece and Cyprus, participating in exhibitions such as HO.RE.CA. Committed to maintaining our high standards, our goal is to expand our retail presence and wholesale points, establishing Rockwell as a leader in the industry. Location Anagnostopoulou 11, Kolonaki Athens, 10673 Contact Phone Number: +30 210 7223336 Website: www.rockwell.gr Email: info@rockwell.gr

Cross country, across donkey paths, through gorges and over calibrated paths. A true experience, you come to places where no tourists will come, in overgrown churches with the most beautiful frescoes and where bats have found their sleeping place. There are regular Griffon vultures flying over because they build their nests in the hills near us. In Summer you witness the swarms of bee-eaters who nest in the area. Our sky at night is very special. Because we do not have light pollution you can observe thousands of stars with the naked eye. In clear weather, it seems that you can touch the Milky Way.  Footscapes of Crete is a very special place.

To Chora, where the local inhabitants drink together and open their homes to say “Welcome.” There, southeast of Naxos and west of Amorgos, on Koufonisia you lose all concept of time and simply put, feel free. Koufonisia is part of the Small Cyclades, a cluster of islands in the southeastern Cyclades. Koufonisia is composed of two small islands, Ano (Upper) and Kato (Lower) Koufonisi as well as Keros. They’ve been inhabited since prehistoric ages. So many people, customs, traditions and different societies have taken root in these places and have left vital traces to be unraveled and understood by the rest of the world. Findings suggest the existence of a Cycladic civilization with evidence from its very early years. Archaeologist Ulrich Köhler in 1884, excavated and discovered The Harpist and The Flute Player along with two female statuettes, which were clear samples of marble sculptures from the Early Cycladic period. Remnants from an ancient Roman civilization were used to establish the present village of Chora which was part of a large Roman settlement that extended up to Loutro. Relics and marble slabs from Early Christianity were discovered on the premises of Saint George and Saint Nicholas churches.
