Όλες οι αίθουσες είναι πλήρως εξοπλισμένες και διαθέτουν όλη την απαραίτητη τεχνική υποστήριξη για να ανταποκριθούν στις προσδοκίες σας και να καλύψουν κάθε ανάγκη των συνεδρίων και εκδηλώσεων σας.  Η δυναμικότητα των τεσσάρων σύγχρονων συνεδριακών αιθουσών κυμαίνεται από 15 έως 150 άτομα, ενώ υπάρχει η δυνατότητα φιλοξενίας έως και 280 ατόμων για την κάλυψη της εκδήλωσής σας. Δύο μόνο βήματα στο εσωτερικό του φτάνουν για να σας συναρπάσουν.  Ο χώρος της υποδοχής, το εστιατόριο και το μπαρ του Olympus Terra Boutique Hotel, που βρίσκονται στο ισόγειο το κτιρίου,  διακοσμήθηκαν αντλώντας έμπνευση από την πλούσια ιστορία της περιοχής και κυρίως από τους μυθικούς θεούς του Ολύμπου. Στους δύο ορόφους του ξενοδοχείου στεγάζονται τα καλαίσθητα μονόκλινα, δίκλινα και τρίκλινα δωμάτια, με θέα σε ήσυχη τοποθεσία της πόλης, στην περιοχή της Γιάννουλης, ενώ ορισμένα από αυτά στην βόρεια κυρίως πλευρά του ξενοδοχείου ατενίζουν το επιβλητικό ορεινό όγκο του Ολύμπου.

Name: Trikorfo Beach
Company description: Trikorfo Beach is an 18.5 acre summer resort built amphitheatrically in an olive yard with respect to the unique environmental conditions and the local architecture. Set on a 250 meter golden-sand beach it extends from the crystal clear waterfront to the near mountain with panoramic and magnificent views of Toroneos Gulf. Trikorfo Beach is a self-sufficient development that features red ceramic-tiled roofs and wooden furniture that bring chic contemporary luxury to your vacation. The resort has independent spacious maisonettes, which stretch on 2 floors, all with a private terrace and garden. Plazas and playgrounds are evenly spaced and independent from the maisonettes. The resort’s beach maisonettes range from family appropriate beach-houses that can accommodate up to four guests to larger maisonettes that are ideal for larger families or groups of friends. The household of each maisonette is more than sufficient to cover the needs of a family. Individually controlled air conditioning and water heating offer perfect living conditions to each guest separately. There is a pleasant lounge and private terrace in every maisonette as well as a fully equipped kitchen and a bathroom with bath products. Our most popular suite is the Junior Maisonette, a 65 sq.m. maisonette, developed in two levels. It has a sloped tiled roof, separate entrance and a balcony with panoramic view. The design allows for exclusive use of a 15 sq.m. stone-paved terrace which is shaded by a wooden pergola in direct contact with the landscaped garden. The maisonette consists of a living room, a fully equipped kitchen-dining room, two bedrooms, a WC-shower and can accommodate up to 4 guests. TRIKORFO BEACH is the ideal summer resort for individual and family vacation.

Name: Destsetters
Company description: Destsetters is one of the most innovative tourism companies that studies the needs of international hoteliers and creates new projects filling the gaps of the industry. Over the last 6 years, the young and passionate team of Destsetters has created 3 successful travel projects, becoming one of the fastest developing group of companies in the global hospitality industry. The well-known Destsetters projects are: Travel by Interest An online platform that helps hoteliers create targeted content easily connecting their booking engine, giving them at the same time effective promotional packages to reach a wide ready-to-buy audience. The online platform www.travelbyinterest.com is already considered the most effective tool for targeting Gay, Luxury, Gastronomy and Wellness travellers and is expected to become the most important hotel content generator for international hoteliers. Hotelier Academy A next-generation Educational Media that focuses on keeping hoteliers updated with new methods, ideas and trends, as well as on creating amazing B2B content that will inspire the global hospitality industry. The modern website www.hotelieracademy.org hosts only top quality content produced by top-level professionals. The project is also expected to launch premium educational content and smart seminars for hotels who want to stand out the competition. Upselling Hotel A new premium service that creates advanced personalised hotel reporting & consulting, for increasing the hotel service sales from current guests. On top of that, the highly qualified Hotel Experts of www.upsellinghotel.com, give birth to strategically specified new hotel concepts that make hotels more attractive. The concepts ensure unique experiences for the guests and high revenue margins for the Hoteliers. What is the key to success of the Destsetters Projects? The high expertise on the global Hotelier Industry and the consistent research on the market's evolutions and new trends.

Name: Ivy Vacation Rentals
Company description: Ivy Vacation Rentals (IVR) is a company established by hospitality professionals built around the idea of providing a variety of services and solutions to owners who aim to elevate either their short-term lease property or expand their own brand. Each managed unit is dedicated to complying with high standards while meeting its profitability, customer satisfaction and employee satisfaction goal. IVR offers expertise in sales management, online reservations systems (IDS) and advisory services. We are able to assist our partners gain competitive advantage as well as achieve a growth of their establishment by offering tailor made solutions designed to meet client expectations.  We offer a wide range of personalized services which responds to all owners’ needs, providing its innovative and holistic model of boutique hotels, villas and apartments management, development and consulting. Our cooperation with travel agencies, as well as our ability to adapt our strategies to the business environment of a business unit, will lead it to the forefront of the tourism market. Experience in the hospitality industry enables us to help our partners grow their business capacity, increase their occupancy, their sales and revenue while reducing labor costs.  Our Vision is to offer high quality and hassle-free accommodation to our guests surpassing their expectations, but at the same time, ensuring our offering is of great value. Working with IVY VACATION RENTALS increases your business’ presence and awareness in the market. SALES AND RESERVATION MANAGEMENT At Ivy Vacation Rentals we analyze the uniqueness of the business environment of the business unit, we study the competition and capitalize on opportunities, with specific strategies to lead us into an integrated framework of actions. Responding to the market needs, we identify the appropriate pricing policy and we create targeted offers.

Name: HOTEL DOGE
Company description: Welcome to DOGE Hotel in the heart of the Venetian port of Chania. DOGE TRADITIONAL HOTEL is an old Venetian house of the 15th century in the old town of Chania. It includes 12 traditional style comfortable rooms for 2-5 people. There is also rooftop terrace where our guests can enjoy the sun. Very close to the hotel is the old Venetian port and 500m away there is a large sandy beach. DOGE HOTEL is 16km from the airport and 7km from Suda bay seaport where is the departure point for the daily sailings to Athens.

Name: Perivolas Hotel
Company description: Originally designed as a family home, Perivolas still feels like a private residence. Intimate in scale and atmosphere, every house is different. Built by native craftsmen using local materials, interiors embody Cycladic style, with its organic forms and smooth surfaces.  Breezy rooms are naturally cooled by sculpted stone walls and vaulted ceilings pierced by skylights. Beds are built into snug alcoves, adorned with a posy of hand-picked flowers. Niches and archways are scooped out of whitewashed walls, low-slung sofas offset by hand-woven rugs and cushions in vivid fuschia and lilac.  Timeless and quietly glamorous, interiors are pared down so that nothing distracts from the show-stopping views and nothing disturbs the intensity of the stillness. Nothing is superfluous, yet nothing has been overlooked. There are no TVs and DVDs – this is a place to switch off.

Name: Loriet Hotel
Company description: Amid the jewels of the Aegean, we find the island of Lesvos, birthplace of Sappho and Alkaios, both famous poets, of the seventh century before Christ. Situated 2km from the capital city, Mitilini, we find the Loriet Hotel, 20 meters opposite the beach and within walking distance of the famous Terriade Museum. The hotel comprises of the Mansion, over 170 years old and restored to its original beauty, including its sixteen hand painted ceilings. The building houses Seven Luxury Suites, Saloon Lounge and Bar, all decorated in antiques. The Hotel The modern complex is comprised of Studios and Modern suites, surrounded by many beautiful fully developed trees. A feature of the Garden is the century old Oleander and Laurel Avenue once used by the Mansion’s horse and carriage. The sea water, in an in ground swimming pool, partly shaded by giant pine trees, is a feature of our Recreation area. A green Garden of Eden where particular attention has been placed to preserve every tree possible, during building the complex, which has created a tranquil haven for many birds and squirrels. All units feature bathrooms, with full size bath, hair-dryer, air condition/heating, free Wireless Internet, refrigerator and room service. All studios and modern suites have a kitchenette. In summer our poolside Cocktail bar, are to be enjoyed by all, and can also be used for a variety of functions, from small to large dinner parties or buffets, handheld with professional care by our expert staff. We at the LORIET Hotel feel we have created a place of beauty, and now invite you to visit us and enjoy its many features.

Name: Santikos Collection
Company description: About us The Santikos Collection, a family run company, was established in 1984, in the small island of Alonissos. Since then we have grown significantly, always striving to create memorable experiences for our guests. We work with a lot of passion and perseverance and have created a brand with an irresistible blend of heritage, lifestyle, culture and elegance. Our collection embraces the local, blending it with a laid-back vibe of luxury. We believe that a hotel can only exist in harmony with its surroundings and the local community, thus we have created the Santikos Selection, a selection of goods from small local producers, for you to enjoy and take back home. We take a lighter, fresher take on luxury and we hope you will enjoy it as much as we do. Santikos Collection properties:   •	Princess Resort, Skiathos  •	Aegean Suites, Skiathos  •	Marpunta Resort , Alonissos  •	Santikos Mansion, Vizitsa, Pelion  •	The Alex, Piraeus Athens

Name: AVA Hotel Athens
Company description: AVA is a boutique hotel, offering some of the most spacious & self contained suites in Athens, fully renovated in January 2010. A sanctuary for business and leisure travellers alike, who desire a sense of space, comfort, exclusiveness and personalized service. Environmentally friendly & a non-smoking hotel.

Name: Elakati Luxury Boutique Hotel
Company description: Elakati Luxury Boutique Hotel is the perfect place to experience true Greek Hospitality. It is an adults only (minimum age of 16 years) themed hotel located in the center of Rhodes, just a few minutes away from all shops, restaurants, bars and a walk away from one of the most beautiful and cosmopolitan beaches on the island of Rhodes, Elli Beach. As a themed hotel the architecture itself takes you on a whole other journey, where each level has a unique design with a theme that reflects the beauty and history of Rhodes. While nature is one of Greece’s beauties, ecological materials are combined to create a traditional atmosphere with modern comforts. Aromas, flavors, and tastes conveniently displayed, ease the search for the perfect gift to take back home. Embracing a healthier lifestyle physically and environmentally, guests can explore the center of Rhodes on an Elakati bicycle made with natural materials itself. Elakati offers a diversity of unforgettable experiences, an adventure unlike no other to discover the treasures of Greek History in modern life. With hospitality running deeply in our roots from ancient times, generosity and courtesy at Elakati Luxury Boutique Hotel are a way of life and all who enter as guests, leave as friends.

Name: Live In Athens
Company description: Hospitality Services in Athens Greece. Live in Athens is about bringing together our team, our guests and the city we love. Since 2012, we select and renovate properties with respect to their history and an intention to elevate both our city and our guests’ experience. We put loads of thought, creativity and excitement in everything we do. We believe that humor, honesty and positive attitude can make the world a better place. Be our guest and become part of our growing family.

Name: Modus Amplio | Hospitality Unlimited
Company description: Modus & Amplio is an independent hospitality company in Greece, providing Hotel & Resort Management, Asset & Brand Management services, Strategy & Operations consulting to hotel owners, developers, investors and lenders. Our approach is different. We ask new questions and open new routes. We create a capability for innovation. Our people are experienced, analytical and passionate providing tailor-made effective solutions. Maximizing our client's business performance is our key objective & adding value to our clients’ business is our mission. Our associates are available to support you with any aspect of Managing, Developing, Owning, or Operating a hospitality property.

Name: HELLAS GROUP
Company description: HELLAS GROUP - HG - is a group of remarkable companies dedicated to sharing the spirit and quality of Greek Hospitality and Gastronomy with the world. A group created with the aim to spread, preserve and encourage the integration of the Greek culture along with all its dimensions in the global landscape. Hellas Group with headquarters in Athens and Shanghai continues pioneering new paths of spreading Greek hospitality to the corners of the world through EROSANTORINI, MY ODYSSEY, HELLAS HOUSE and its respective brands. MY ODYSSEY TRAVEL, a luxury travel agency providing bespoke travel to Greece and Europe (Athens & Shanghai) EROSANTORINI, year round, first truly private estate on Santorini island HELLAS HOUSE, the Greek Culture & Lifestyle Center in Shanghai  AGAVE, design boutique hotel in Santorini ELAION, top early-harvest olive oil  TSELEPOS, finest Greek wines MILOS, authentic Greek restaurant in Shanghai  AMPHORA, food & spirits import trade enterprise in Shanghai HOW, authentic experience retail store featuring natural Greek products including honey, olive oil, wines and cosmetics in Shanghai

Name: Crucial Hospitality
Company description: Crucial Hospitality is a professional full service Hotel, Villas and Apartments Management Company. The organization’s aim is to assist property owners in developing their investment value and at the same time, to create a housing portfolio that, through capital investment, will be upgraded, repositioned on the tourism market and will increase its commercial value. CRUCIAL is the sole management company which offers a wide range of personalized services which responds to all owners’ needs, providing its innovative and holistic model of hotel, villas and apartment’s management, development and consulting. Experience in the hospitality industry enables us to help our partners grow significantly their business capacity, increase their occupancy, their sales and revenue while reducing labor costs.  Crucial Hospitality offers expertise in sales management, global management, online reservations systems (IDS) and advisory services.  It is able to assist its partners to gain competitive advantages as well as achieve a growth of their establishment by providing the most advanced tools to run a property and by offering tailor made solutions designed to meet client expectations. Our Vision is to offer high quality and hassle-free accommodation to our guests surpassing their expectations, but at the same time, ensuring our offering is of great value.

Name: Sparrow
HQ Location: Greece, Attica, Athens, 39 Leoforos Dimarchou Aggelou Metaxa, 16674
Company description: Sparrow is a property management company operating in Greece that helps property owners to lease their property on accommodation-sharing sites with the best terms. For us, the proper management of your property concerns both the organization, supervision and optimization of digital channels, as well as the organization, supervision and maintenance of your property itself. Our goal is to differentiate your listing from competition and increase your bookings and income. We recommend realistic solutions and we create with you the optimal strategy for the promotion and best performance of your space. But we do not stop there; we find, evaluate and communicate with potential guests while keeping you informed of the bookings and your income at all times.

Name: Hospitality Investment | Greece
Company description: Hospitality Investment is a boutique firm involved in business study, renovation, marketing and commercial development, management and operations of hospitality properties, as well as property hunting, on both the island of Aegina and Attica.

Name: Hosthub
Company description: Hosthub helps vacation rental owners manage their listings on multiple channels like Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Tripadvisor, etc thus multiplying their revenue by 2X.

Name: Athens Wine Tasting
Company description: ATHENS WINE TASTING Private Company specializes in intimate, unforgettable wine and food attractions. We offer small, semi-private and private wine tastings and excursions to explore the magnificent wine region of Attica and the most noteworthy wines of Greece. Our passionate and sophisticated wine experts will ensure you experience the best wine tasting courses and tours. A must-do experience for all wine lovers. We love to nurture our guests about Greece’s tastiest wines many of which they have never heard of. Our fun but professional approach will deliver an unforgettable experience and when you leave, you know much more about the wines of this country and wine tastings.

Name: TU Events
Company description: Όλα ξεκίνησαν από αγάπη, μεράκι και αφοσίωση στο κρασί, την γαστρονομία και την επιμονή στην δημιουργία υπηρεσιών υψηλής ποιότητας. TU σημαίνει Touratzis Umami και ιδρύθηκε σαν εταιρία από τον Γιώργο Τουρατζή MSc το 2014.  Οι αμέτρητες δοκιμές και τα ταξίδια σε κορυφαία εστιατόρια και οινοποιεία του κόσμου, ήταν ίσως οι σημαντικότερες σπουδές, για έναν γαστρονομικό ουρανίσκο. Με την επιστροφή του στην Αλεξανδρούπολη, ξεκίνησε μια νέα σειρά γαστρονομικών & οινικών event, μαζί με το website πρότασης εστιατορίων με την ονομασία Touratzis Umami. Η Εξέλιξη Έπειτα από επανειλημμένες παρουσιάσεις οίνου και γαστρονομικά δείπνα με γνωστούς και ανερχόμενους σεφ, ιδρύθηκε η διοργανώτρια εταιρεία premium εκδηλώσεων, TU events. Μια δυναμική ομάδα νέων ανθρώπων δημιουργήθηκε, που με αγάπη, πείσμα και χαμόγελο αναπτύσσεται και πραγματοποιεί με παραδειγματικό τρόπο κάθε νέα ιδέα. Η TU events αναλαμβάνει, σχεδιάζει και διοργανώνει πρότυπα projects, όπως είναι τα One Wine Stand, τα γαστρονομικά δείπνα και φυσικά το μεγαλύτερο μας project, το Umami Festival! Boutique Hospitality Projects Κάθε project, που δημιουργούμε ή αναλαμβάνουμε, έχει δικό του μοναδικό σχεδιασμό με στόχο μας πάντα, να “γράφουμε τη δική μας σελίδα”, ξεφεύγοντας από οτιδήποτε άλλο έχουμε δει. Όσο για την ποιότητα και την επιμονή στις λεπτομέρειες, κρατάμε πάντα την υπόσχεση μας για premium αποτελέσματα, έτσι αν θέλουμε να περιγράψουμε με τρεις λέξεις αυτό που εκφράζουμε, είναι “Boutique Hospitality Projects”! Γιατί Umami; Το Umami (ουμάμι) είναι η πέμπτη γευστική αίσθηση (γλυκό, ξινό, πικρό, αλμυρό & Umami). Είναι δάνειο από την Ιαπωνική, όπου μπορεί να μεταφραστεί ως «ευχάριστη νόστιμη γεύση». Σε μια επέκταση του ουμάμι λοιπόν, βασίζεται η ονομασία TU, προβάλλοντας αντίστοιχα κάτι νέο, διαφορετικό και φυσικά νόστιμο!

Name: Prima Lodging
Company description: Prima Lodging offers smart homes for short-term and long-term accommodation in Thessaloniki. The first apartment opened in November 2018 in the municipality of Kalamaria Thessaloniki. This innovative self-catering accommodation offers a new way of self check-in via video doorbell and smart lock, available 24 hours a day, without the presence of a host or other staff. The Google Home assistant inside the apartments can be used for in-house commands such as voice control of the smart lights or information regarding the local area. Guests may relax on the furnished balcony with city view, play any of the console’s pre-installed video games or watch Netflix on the large full HD TV. Our goal is to offer small affordable smart homes combined with competitive amenities using smart interior design choices for space saving.

Name: Batis Multiplex
Company description: With a breathtaking view, MULTIPLEX Batis in Kavala, Greece, will enchant you from the first moment ... The autonomous Batis Multiplex, located in one of the most beautiful beaches 4km. west of Kavala, Greece, is one of the most tempting incentive to visit the region of Kavala. It impresses with its independence, functionality, modern aesthetics and natural beauty. Batis Multiplex is the ideal meeting place for any personal, social or professional time. It is a well-organized recreation area, which offers unlimited residence to kids and adults, relaxation and entertainment throughout the day from early morning until late evening.
